thesis: IonQ is the largest and most commercially advanced publicly traded quantum computing pure-play, a full-stack trapped-ion leader whose FY2025 revenue tripled to $130.02M (+201.9% YoY) — the strongest near-term commercial traction in the group. A fortress ~$2.03B cash-and-investments balance sheet (built via equity raises into the 2025-26 quantum rally) funds a roadmap toward 256-qubit systems and a stated 2 million physical qubits by 2030, while the SkyWater semiconductor foundry acquisition, a $2B federal quantum funding wave with government equity stakes, and a Strong Buy analyst consensus (average target ~$69) underpin the bull thesis. The counterweight is stark: a rich ~68x EV/revenue valuation, a FY2025 GAAP net loss of ($510.38M), heavy cash burn, and a stock that has round-tripped from an $84.64 high to near its 52-week low — this is a high-beta, binary, milestone-driven speculation.

drivers: Roadmap execution — 256-qubit prototype scaling toward the 2 million physical qubit 2030 target with rising fidelity and logical-qubit milestones
SkyWater foundry acquisition secures domestic chip supply and vertically integrates manufacturing, de-risking scale-up
Federal quantum funding wave and government equity stakes scale contract revenue and validate the sector
Enterprise and cloud adoption (AWS Braket, Azure Quantum, Google Cloud) plus quantum networking and Clavis XG security drive commercial revenue beyond hardware sales
Strategic acquisition interest or a quantum 'tipping point' re-rates the cohort back toward prior highs

base_case.assumptions: Revenue continues scaling off the $130M base toward $250-400M by 2027-2028 as hardware and services both ramp; the ~$2.03B cash pile funds the roadmap without a forced raise; gross margin stabilizes in the 40-50% range; Strong Buy consensus holds and the stock re-rates modestly above current levels as milestones land on schedule; path to EBITDA breakeven remains multi-year

risks: A quantum winter compresses sector multiples and the ~68x EV/revenue premium collapses
Roadmap milestones slip and the 2-million-qubit-by-2030 target proves aspirational amid quantum's history of over-promising
Persistent heavy cash burn ($299.6M FCF outflow in FY2025) and further equity issuance drive dilution
Competing modalities (superconducting at IBM/Google, neutral atom, photonic) reach commercial scale first
SkyWater integration disappoints or government funding and equity-stake dynamics create overhang

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — read on revenue momentum, cash burn, and guidance
SkyWater Technology acquisition close and integration (final regulatory approval received)
256-qubit chip prototype and modular system milestones; logical-qubit progress
Federal quantum funding awards and government equity-stake developments

key_risks: Extreme valuation: a ~$12.65B market cap on $130M FY2025 revenue (~68x EV/revenue) leaves no room for execution error
Pre-profitability with a FY2025 GAAP net loss of ($510.38M) and ($299.6M) free cash flow; a multi-year path to breakeven
Quantum computing commercialization timeline uncertain; sector has a long history of over-promising on qubit milestones
High beta (~3.2) and severe volatility — the stock has round-tripped from an $84.64 high toward its 52-week low
Dilution risk from continued equity issuance; SkyWater integration and government equity-stake overhang
Competitive technology risk from superconducting, neutral-atom, and photonic approaches reaching scale first
